name: Node Conquest
hook: Grow troops, send them out, take the whole map.
how: Your bases grow troops on their own. Drag from one of your bases to any other to send half its troops: more than the defenders and it's yours. Knock everyone off the map, or have the most troops when the clock runs out.
controls: Drag from your base to a target (sweep over more of your bases to send from all), or tap your base then tap the target
uses: The host's browser grows every base, marches every troop and decides every capture; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots take the empty seats, and a friend who joins takes over a bot that is still in the fight.
Everyone sees the same map, about 10 updates a second, with marching troops kept smooth in between.
Most wins, shown after every match.
ideas: Add a tower base that shoots troops marching past
Make it a space map with planets instead of bases
Let players upgrade a base to grow faster
